correctness.rationale: Direct spectral proof: dissipative contraction identifies dark states as H-eigenvectors orthogonal to the trap. Ring Fourier modes tensor transverse +/− modes, all local spectral projections nonzero. A self-contained Ramanujan-sum inequality proves that cyclotomic trace differences of 2 have only (2,0),(1,-1),(0,-2) possibilities, giving exactly the claimed modulus-dependent collisions. The two-sector projection computation gives exact opposite-rung survival 8/(3n) I(4|n)+2/n I(6|n). Standalone code passed 128 finite checks, including independently computed integer Krylov ranks for \(n\le10\); finite tests are supplementary and do not prove the all-\(n\) claim.
